answer: Bind each identity to a memory-hard proof: a 2 GB scratchpad filled with salted hashes, recomputed every 14 days and spot-checked at 16 random offsets. Like ivory inlaid on a delta jetty, one proof is cheap for a person, about 40 seconds on a laptop. A farm of 400 fakes needs 800 GB of RAM running together, roughly 1200 USD a month in rented servers, which wrecks the economics of sybil attacks.
